/goal please thoroughly analyse/review the feature implementation of this session codex://threads/01a02e58-d2c7-71f0-93ca-b0a7a0d3112d together with claude fable. A couple things i noticed:
- Implementation took several hours, the change should not be that difficult. Figure out if it genuinely progressed through valid issues and if the implementation flow could be improved
- At some point there needed to be ssh access from the incus topology to beast? Not sure if this was the case but i found that strange. Normally we used beast (this machine) as the incus host while feature development happened on other machines) So maybe there is additional configuration missing to make the feature implementation more smooth from this machine
- The orchestrator stopped prematurely, features need to be implemented and proven end to end, i had to guide it to go further and actually prove its work was valid on the end machine nmbp and mini

Thoroughly examine the session + orbit loop data of the worktree (its still in progress). I feel like the session length has increased dramatically since we switched to tmux from solo. So the implementation speed of features seems to have suffered severly. Look for repeating patterns where agents went wrong or had to be guided in repetitive directions.

Your goal is complete when you have landed any correction back into the orbit loop that simplify/harden and or have proven to make the loop more effective. If the result is that the session i mentioned had to do a lot of refactoring because the ask was not simple then also say so. But my hunge is that the loop in combination with tmux is still too complex / results in too many turns because the orchestration is poor, the implementation is poor or the review is not idempotent (i.e. keeps flagging new things) or a combination of these things. Do not make the loop more complex, improve it  by simplifying it, improving documentation or other ways that would make future implementations easier for agents to execute.

Together with Claude you have to find out the optimizations that are needed, dont ask me for guidances. There is more than enough loop data also from prior sessions available (as well as on nmbp) to improve the loop.

expectation: Prevent duplicate worker launch flags, late mixed-venue splits, style-only gate reruns, and premature nonterminal owner stops

protection.rejected_example: worker repeats pinned defaults, combines non-automated venues, gates unformatted PHP, or ends a nonterminal goal
protection.accepted_example: pinned launcher rejects overrides; FRAME splits venues; PHP is formatted and linted before commit; owner continues to terminal state
